notes: v1.0.12 — Anti-Crash System (Shader Guard) + FPS Boost pushed further. Shader Guard: real GPU/driver assessment before shader sessions, VRAM-aware render distance auto-reduction, auto-recovery after a shader crash (next session launches with shaders disabled + clear message), shader-pattern detection in the Crash Assistant, new Stability section in Settings. FPS: LOD for distant chunks, async chunk upload, overdraw reduction, texture-atlas batching, and a new Turbo preset (max FPS trade-off, never default).
